## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated hardware-free tests.
- [ ] Ran `python -m pytest -q` from the repository root.
- [ ] Ran relevant synthetic checks.
- [ ] Completed the manual smoke test if camera behavior changed.
- [ ] Updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Verified no private config, serial, path, credential, weight, raw data, or generated output is included.
- [ ] Did not describe software tests as scientific validation.
